data.title: Bitcoin slumps as strong jobs report boosts chance of Fed rate hike; Dow falls 226 points, odds of rate hike in September at 58%.
data.description: The Dow experienced a decrease of 226 points and Bitcoin reversed some of its previous gains following the release of August payroll numbers, which were three times higher than expected. This increase in employment figures has raised the probability of a rate hike in September to 58%.

data.title: NKB Inc.: Limited Edition: High-Definition Giclée Prints of Katsuhiro Otomo’s Ginza Station Public Art “Procession Spin” Now Available
data.description: In Tokyo, NKB Inc. has released high-definition Giclée prints of "Procession Spin," a ceramic relief public art piece by manga artist and director Katsuhiro Otomo. Each print, from an exclusive collection overseen by Otomo, is hand-signed and numbered. Headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, NKB's President, Takayuki Toya, led the project. The prints are based on Otomo's original artwork and aim to capture the essence of "Procession Spin." The collection features a limited edition of prints, each carrying a unique number assigned by Otomo.

data.title: Epsilon Energy Ltd. Announces Quarterly Dividend
data.description: Epsilon Energy Ltd. disclosed today that its Board of Directors has approved a dividend of $0.0625 per common stock share (equating to an annualized amount of $0.25 per share) for shareholders on record as of September 15, 2026. The dividend will be disbursed on September 30, 2026. It is worth noting that all dividends issued by the Company are classified as "eligible dividends" under subsection 89(1) of the Income Tax Act (Canada), unless stated otherwise. Epsilon is listed on the NASDAQ exchange under the symbol EPSN.

data.title: New Pit Master Takes Over San Bernardino Dickey’s, Brings Fresh Perspective to Hometown Restaurant
data.description: In Los Angeles, the San Bernardino community will see a change in ownership at their Dickey’s Barbecue Pit as Tuan “Danny” Nguyen steps in as the new owner of the restaurant situated at 1725 Northpark Blvd. W., Suite A1. Taking on the role of Pit Master, Nguyen, a local resident, commenced his duties earlier this summer. Thrilled about the opportunity to showcase his love for barbecue, hospitality, and community engagement, Nguyen is eager to strengthen the restaurant's ties with the local residents.
